sources.title: RoboDojo: A Unified Sim-and-Real Benchmark for Comprehensive Evaluation ...
sources.snippet: RoboDojo is a unified sim-and-real benchmark for comprehensive evaluation of generalist robot manipulation policies, with 42 simulation tasks, 18 real-world tasks, and a public leaderboard.

sources.snippet: Highlights Overview of RoboDojo. RoboDojo unifies efficient simulation evaluation and reproducible real-world testing for generalist robot manipulation, covering 42 simulation tasks, 18 real-world tasks, heterogeneous parallel simulation, RoboDojo-RealEval, XPolicyLab, and a continuously updated leaderboard.
